summary: Verify Nightly run 43052048010 overran the 2400 s task budget on @libs/games-harness-ts#test:spec:22 and ran past the shard deadline on part 24: the spec split sized secret-choices' 133 nightly replays as if each cost the ~28 s a standard replay does, so its three files of ~45 replays each filled a part. Its replays are far heavier: every trace that finishes the game plays a whole Hearts match (~630 moves, ~140 s locally, five times the mean replay), and two of the three files held five such traces. The replay plan now records the model's measured nightlyReplayCost, and the split sizes its nightly files and parts by it.
